incident: The formal run loaded baseline-v0/train_eval_sample_final.pkl. The artifact contains an embedded Test split, so loading it deserialized Test even though the training loop consumed only Train and Validation.
impact: All checkpoints, logs, and training history from this directory are invalid for model selection, reporting, or PPT evidence.
The Validation evaluator rejected the embedded-Test artifact before emitting metrics.
remediation: Do not delete, overwrite, reuse, or evaluate this run directory.
Build a new History-10 selection artifact whose top-level keys are exactly Train and Validation before any replacement run.
Use a fresh external experiment directory and a newly frozen preregistration for any replacement run.
